# v1.12.4 — Duplicate phone notifications fixed

## Notification delivery

- Fixed each task mention arriving twice when a phone was registered for both FCM and ntfy. The backend now uses one phone delivery channel per user per event: ntfy is sent only when FCM did not deliver (for example, no registered device or Google rejected the send).
- Kept ntfy available as the fallback and for the ntfy diagnostic; stale-token cleanup remains in place.
- Refreshed the mobile unread-notification badge on board sync events, so FCM-only users do not depend on an ntfy event to update it.
- Added a short identical-message dedupe guard for ntfy redeliveries after socket reconnects.

## Bundled deployment/build hardening

- Included the preceding v1.12.3 FCM deployment improvements: backend images can ship with the service-account credential supplied through CI, derive the Firebase project from that credential, and run without separately configuring a server-side FCM mount/environment pair.
- Hardened credential validation and transport: CI base64-encodes the multiline JSON for Docker build arguments, and both the workflow and image build verify service-account fields before producing an image.
- Broadened ignore protection for service-account JSON files so renamed credential copies are less likely to enter Git.

## Verification

- Backend Python compilation and the duplicate-channel AST check passed; Docker Compose configuration and Flutter analysis passed; all 17 Flutter tests passed with Flutter 3.24.3.
- Mobile package version: **1.12.4+17**.
